title: EIA updates world oil transit chokepoints report
description: U.S. Energy Information Administration published updated chokepoint flow data, noting continued strategic importance of the Strait of Hormuz for global oil transit at 20.9 million barrels per day.

title: EIA reports Bab el-Mandeb disruptions affect oil transit
description: EIA reports that attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb have led to reroutings around the Cape of Good Hope, increasing transit times and freight costs.

title: IEA oil market report highlights supply security concerns
description: International Energy Agency monthly oil market report discusses global supply security and the importance of chokepoint stability for energy-importing nations.

title: PPAC releases FY 2023-24 crude import data
description: Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell published annual import statistics showing India imported 232.1 million tonnes of crude oil in FY 2023-24, with Iraq as the largest single supplier.

title: OPEC monthly report discusses production policy adjustments
description: OPEC monthly oil market report covers production levels and demand outlook, noting voluntary production adjustments by several members.
sourceOrganization: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
